title: Brought compliance checks into the company AI platform
summary: I got my requirements compliance check, against IEC 62304, FDA and INCOSE guidance, built into the company's AI platform as a predefined prompt that any team can use without a license.
what_would_have_happened: The check would stay a personal tool that teams had to ask me for.
the_call: Put the check on a platform teams already use, with no license needed.
what_i_did: Designed the prompt, published step-by-step instructions and offered demos and help extending it to other teams' use cases.
what_changed: Available to any team on the platform; a user said it made requirements review much simpler.
